data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure in the right order (origin, destination, trip type and dates, search, continue, Sort & Filter, apply), but it leaves out the payment type (cash or points) parameter and hardcodes the sort to "Price (low to high)" even though sort_option varies (the true run picked "Price by Core"), so an automation built from it would miss a varying input and be partly vague.
